review_time_definition: Wall-clock from first detailed response inspection to submission; includes coordinator/tool latency, not isolated human labor.

anchors.quote: Encode indices from col through n-1 in a basis-state register, with explicit rejection of unused states. Provide coherent access to the active column of the current augmented rows and reversible binary64-compatible absolute-value and comparison operations. The predicate must establish that no candidate has a larger magnitude and that no earlier candidate has an equal magnitude. Encoding and updating the mutable dense row state, handling intermediate nonfinite values, and uncomputing comparison workspace remain unresolved.
For every nonempty remaining range there is exactly one marked first-maximum index, including an all-zero range whose selected pivot is subsequently rejected by the classical zero-pivot check.
Python-compatible floating-point comparison, arithmetic, nonfinite-intermediate handling, and exception semantics are not supplied as reversible circuits.
This conditional plan records only structural representability as finite predicate search. It does not establish practical suitability, semantic equivalence, or quantum advantage.

binding.rationale: The revision now explicitly states two Boolean conditions: no candidate has a larger magnitude, and no earlier candidate has an equal magnitude. These are negated existential > and == comparisons, not the historical universal >= condition. Nonfinite handling remains unresolved but no executable guard restricts the domain. Check the literal relation with guard True; conditional future circuit feasibility and whole-plan equivalence remain unjudged.

interpretations.meaning: Literal no-larger and no-earlier-equal conditions on absolute pivot values.
interpretations.expression: not any(values[k] > values[i] for k in indices) and not any(values[j] == values[i] for j in indices if j < i)
